recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-12048 in core; future value-set relocation or typo cleanup should be handled only through their own Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-12048 asked how to represent HL7 v2 A20/NPU-2 bed statuses such as closed, housekeeping, occupied, contaminated, and isolated when Location.status is required-bound to only active, inactive, and suspended. The accepted resolution added Location.operationalStatus 0..1 Coding with a preferred binding to the v2-0116 bed-status value set and a description covering operational values for beds, rooms, units, chairs, contamination, housekeeping, and maintenance.
initial_application: Git commit 3e4dd26ef51c6ba90a3bcad1e3fb51e317ac05bb explicitly listed tracker 12048 and added operationalStatus to the old Location spreadsheet source, added a room example with v2-0116 Housekeeping, and added an operational-status search parameter. Later source refactoring carried the element into source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml, and terminology URL migration moved v2-0116 references to terminology.hl7.org.
additional_context: Location is active in source/fhir.ini. The current Location source keeps Location.status as the lifecycle/general availability code and explains that current operational values may be represented by operationalStatus. Location.operationalStatus is present as 0..1 Coding with a preferred binding to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v2-0116 and the requested operational-status definition. FHIR-55300 later confirms Location.operationalStatus is already in THO; FHIR-41741 was a retracted typo issue against the same binding description and does not alter the seed decision. Zulip origin evidence matches the Jira request, and Confluence searches found no conflicting meeting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current core source already satisfies FHIR-12048. No source edit was necessary.
